objs.name: document
objs.description: Main document artifact in DHC VISION; covers various document types and contains metadata and lifecycle information.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for the document type; used in the document name.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, 4-digit number assigned per document type; included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Document title used in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version of the document; used in versioning and display.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope(s) of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References attribute; part of the document properties.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications referenced by the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Relevant companies or areas of validity.

attributes.name: areas_of_validity
attributes.description: Areas of validity for the document.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Users or groups who are granted read access to the document.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Author(s) of the document; default is the creator; can be changed.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional authors who may contribute; not part of the release workflow.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Users who review the content for technical and formal aspects.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: User who releases the document to readers.

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Translator for language versions of released content.

attributes.name: distribution_list
attributes.description: Distribution lists; groups or individuals informed about release and/or acknowledged.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the current version is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Defined period for validity extension (default 3 years).

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the version remains valid.
